Title: [SECURITY] Passwords stored and compared in plain text
Description: Passwords are stored and compared in plain text without any hashing. In LoginAuthPostEndpoint.cs, login does direct comparison "loginValue.password == user.Password". In PersonAddEndpoint.cs, EmployeeAddNewEndpoint.cs, AdminPanelEndpoints.cs (AddUser, AddEmployee), and ProfileSettingsEditEndpoint.cs, the password is saved as entered. The Person.cs model holds Password as a plain string. Fix: Use one-way hashing before storing passwords (e.g., BCrypt, Argon2id, or built-in ASP.NET Core PasswordHasher<T>). During login, compare the hash of the entered password with the stored hash. Never store or compare passwords in their original form. Files: LoginAuthPostEndpoint.cs, PersonAddEndpoint.cs, EmployeeAddNewEndpoint.cs, AdminPanelEndpoints.cs, ProfileSettingsEditEndpoint.cs, Person.cs

Title: [SECURITY] API returns passwords to client in responses
Description: In ProfileGetUserInfoEndpoint.cs, Password is mapped to the response object (ProfileGetUserInfoResponse), meaning every call to api/ProfileEndpoint/GetUserInfo/{token} sends the plain text password to the frontend. PersonGetAllEndpoint.cs returns complete Person objects without projection, and since the model has no [JsonIgnore] on Password, it gets serialized. Fix: Create separate DTO objects for each response that never contain a password field. Add [JsonIgnore] on Password property as additional protection. Files: ProfileGetUserInfoEndpoint.cs, PersonGetAllEndpoint.cs, Person.cs

Title: [SECURITY] No ASP.NET authentication pipeline configured
Description: Program.cs calls UseAuthorization() but has no UseAuthentication(), no registered JWT or Cookie scheme, no [Authorize] attributes or policy-based authorization. Security relies on manual _authService.IsLogged() calls scattered across some endpoints, while many endpoints have no protection at all. Fix: Implement JWT Bearer authentication (or cookie-based), register the scheme in Program.cs, add UseAuthentication() before UseAuthorization(), and protect endpoints with [Authorize]. Public endpoints (login, registration) should be marked with [AllowAnonymous]. Files: Program.cs, all endpoint files

Title: [SECURITY] Write endpoints publicly accessible without authentication
Description: The following endpoints allow anonymous users to create, modify, and delete data: RoleController (POST/DELETE), VetController (POST/PUT/DELETE), InventoryController (POST/PUT/DELETE), AdminController (POST/PUT/DELETE — anyone can create an admin), NurseController, BarberController, CategoryController, ProductController, FAQController, SpeciesController, SubCategoryController, all controllers in Controllers/ folder. Also: AppointmentAddEndpoint, AppointmentCancelEndpoint, AppointmentRescheduleEndpoint, AvailabilityAddEndpoint/Edit/Delete, EmployeeAddNewEndpoint, AnimalGetByOwnerIdEndpoint, PersonGetAllEndpoint. Fix: Every data-modifying endpoint must require authentication, and administrative operations must have role checks (RBAC). Files: All controllers and unprotected endpoints

Title: [SECURITY] 2FA verification bypassed — login succeeds without verification
Description: In LoginAuthPostEndpoint.cs HandleAsync method, when the system detects an unverified user (!userProfile.verified), it generates a verification token, sends an email, but does NOT stop execution (no return statement). Code continues, creates a valid AuthentificationToken and returns it. Unverified users get a fully functional token. Fix: Inside the if (!userProfile.verified) block, after sending the email, immediately return an appropriate response (e.g., Unauthorized) and never issue a session token to an unverified user. Files: LoginAuthPostEndpoint.cs

Title: [SECURITY] Profile endpoint allows reading other users' profiles (IDOR)
Description: ProfileGetUserInfoEndpoint.cs accepts a token from the URL (GetUserInfo/{token}), checks only if the caller is logged in (via header token), then loads another user's profile based on the URL token. If a logged-in user knows or guesses another's token, they can retrieve the complete profile including the password. Fix: The endpoint should always return the profile of the currently logged-in user based on the authentication header token, not based on a URL parameter. Files: ProfileGetUserInfoEndpoint.cs

Title: [SECURITY] Pet endpoints have IDOR — any user can manipulate others' pets
Description: PetsGetByIdEndpoint.cs returns pet data without ownership check. PetsSoftDeleteEndpoint.cs and PetsRestoreEndpoint.cs allow delete/restore of any pet by ID with only IsLogged() check. PetsUpdateOrInsertEndpoint.cs loads animal by request.Id without ownership verification. PetsReportEndpoint.cs accepts OwnerId from query string and generates PDF for any owner. Fix: On every resource access, verify that the current user (extracted from token) owns the resource. Example: add WHERE Id = @petId AND OwnerId = @currentUserId. Files: PetsGetByIdEndpoint.cs, PetsSoftDeleteEndpoint.cs, PetsRestoreEndpoint.cs, PetsUpdateOrInsertEndpoint.cs, PetsReportEndpoint.cs

Title: [SECURITY] Employee endpoints missing role checks (RBAC)
Description: EmployeeEditEndpoint.cs and EmployeeDeleteEndpoint.cs only check IsLogged() — no role verification. Any registered user (pet owner) can modify employee data including RoleId (privilege escalation) or soft-delete any employee. Fix: Implement role checks so only users with appropriate roles (e.g., admin or head vet) can perform operations on employees. Files: EmployeeEditEndpoint.cs, EmployeeDeleteEndpoint.cs

Title: [SECURITY] AnimalGetByOwnerIdEndpoint is a public data enumerator
Description: Returns animals for any arbitrary ownerId without authentication. An attacker can iterate through IDs and collect data about all animals and their owners. Fix: Require authentication and restrict queries to animals belonging to the currently logged-in user. Files: AnimalGetByOwnerIdEndpoint.cs

Title: [SECURITY] Logout sends token in URL and lacks proper authorization
Description: LoginAuthDeleteEndpoint.cs uses route DELETE api/LoginAuth/Delete/{token} without checking if the token belongs to the logged-in user. Token in URL ends up in server logs, browser history, reverse proxy logs, and referer headers. Anyone who knows a token can terminate another's session. If token doesn't exist in DB, NullReferenceException occurs. Fix: Logout should operate on the current session identified from header/cookie, not from a URL token. Files: LoginAuthDeleteEndpoint.cs

Title: [SECURITY] Verification token expiry not checked during verification
Description: VerificationPostEndpoint.cs checks only tokenObj.Token == loginValue.token and completely ignores the ExpiresAt field. It relies on TokenCleanupService to delete expired tokens every 5 minutes, leaving a window where expired tokens can be used. Fix: Endpoint must explicitly check tokenObj.ExpiresAt > DateTime.UtcNow before accepting the token. Files: VerificationPostEndpoint.cs

Title: [SECURITY] Console logs with auth/debug data left in frontend
Description: In login.component.ts, verification-page.component.ts, MyAuth.ts, and other components, console.log calls print auth tokens and debug information. Anyone can open the browser console and see sensitive data. Fix: Remove all debug logs from the final version or replace them with a centralized logger that can be disabled in production. Files: login.component.ts, verification-page.component.ts, MyAuth.ts

Title: [BUG] Appointment system lacks basic scheduling integrity
Description: AppointmentAddEndpoint.cs does not check if a time slot is actually available before booking — it just sets IsAvailable = false without checking the current value. Two appointments can be created for the same slot. Additionally, the endpoint doesn't verify: slot belongs to the chosen employee, slot belongs to the vet station, AnimalId belongs to CustomerId. AppointmentCancelEndpoint.cs and AppointmentRescheduleEndpoint.cs have no authentication. Fix: Check slot availability (WHERE IsAvailable = true in UPDATE), verify slot-employee-station chain, verify animal belongs to the booking user. Files: AppointmentAddEndpoint.cs, AppointmentCancelEndpoint.cs, AppointmentRescheduleEndpoint.cs

Title: [BUG] VetStationEditEndpoint.cs has logic bugs in field updates
Description: Nullable bool fields are updated based on the old DB value instead of the request value: "if (_vetStation.InOffice != null) _vetStation.InOffice = vetStation.InOffice;" — the condition checks the old value, so if the field was null, it can never be set. Same applies to OnField, Parking, Wheelchair, Wifi. Additionally, image upload is bound to Description instead of StationImage — images will never save correctly. Files: VetStationEditEndpoint.cs

Title: [BUG] TimeSlotGetEndpoint.cs has duplicate Day check and missing Year check
Description: Condition: "x.SlotDateTime.Day == _date.Day && x.SlotDateTime.Month == _date.Month && x.SlotDateTime.Day == _date.Day" — .Day is checked twice, .Year is never checked. Slots for March 15, 2026 would also return slots for March 15, 2027, 2028, etc. Fix: Replace with x.SlotDateTime.Date == _date.Date. Also fix fragile manual date parsing (new DateTime(int.Parse(date.Split("-")[0]), ...)) — use DateTime.TryParseExact and return BadRequest on invalid format. Files: TimeSlotGetEndpoint.cs

Title: [BUG] CustomerValidator has inverted logic — validation never triggers
Description: Condition: "if (!(customer.MembershipLoyalty > 1 && customer.MembershipLoyalty < 0))" — no number can be simultaneously > 1 and < 0, so the condition in parentheses is always false, and its negation is always true. Validation never activates. Fix: Use || (OR) instead of && (AND). Files: CustomerValidator

Title: [BUG] MainVetController.Edit does not update anything
Description: Code reads: "mainvet.Id = _mainvet.Id; _db.SaveChanges();" — only sets the input ID to the existing entity's ID and calls SaveChanges(). No other property is updated. The edit endpoint exists but does nothing useful. Files: MainVetController

Title: [BUG] AppointmentAddEndpoint adds to EF change tracker before validation
Description: The endpoint calls _db.Appointment.Add(appointment) before checking if the time slot exists. If slot doesn't exist, BadRequest is returned but the appointment is already in the change tracker. Fix: Always validate first, then add to the change tracker. Files: AppointmentAddEndpoint.cs

Title: [BUG] Frontend authentication is broken
Description: In my-auth-interceptor.ts, the Authorization header line is commented out — the interceptor does nothing. Additionally, getAuthorizationToken() returns Promise<string> but the interceptor treats it as a plain string without await. AutentifikacijaHelper (auth.ts) has a completely different model with BHS naming that looks copy-pasted from another project. Frontend uses axios directly instead of Angular HttpClient, bypassing Angular interceptors. Fix: Uncomment and fix the interceptor, properly await the async token, use Angular HttpClient consistently. Files: my-auth-interceptor.ts, auth.ts, components using axios

Title: [BUG] Registration redirects to protected route without login token
Description: In register.component.ts, after successful registration, this.router.navigate(["home-page"]) is called — but the user has no auth token since they just registered. Fix: After registration, either auto-login the user (issue a token), redirect to login page, or redirect to email verification page. Files: register.component.ts

Title: [BUG] Availability and TimeSlot logic can lead to inconsistent state
Description: AvailabilityAddEndpoint.cs immediately generates slots for 30 days, while AppointmentGeneratorService (background service) also generates slots — potential duplicates. AvailabilityEditEndpoint.cs changes availability but doesn't regenerate future slots. AvailabilityDeleteEndpoint.cs deletes availability but doesn't clean up future slots. Working day check is commented out in AppointmentGeneratorService. Slots from endpoint vs background service have different SlotDateTime formats. Fix: Consolidate slot generation logic and ensure consistency. Files: AvailabilityAddEndpoint.cs, AvailabilityEditEndpoint.cs, AvailabilityDeleteEndpoint.cs, AppointmentGeneratorService

Title: [BUG] Employee model redefines Id from Person — breaks EF Core TPT
Description: Employee inherits Person (which has Id), but Employee redeclares its own [Key] public int Id. DataContext.cs has a comment acknowledging this. This causes AdminPanelEndpoints.cs to use ExecuteSqlRaw for manual inserts into Employee, Vet, and MainVet tables. Fix: Refactor inheritance hierarchy — either properly use TPT without redefining Id, or abandon inheritance in favor of composition (separate tables with foreign key relationships). Files: Employee.cs, Person.cs, DataContext.cs, AdminPanelEndpoints.cs

Title: [QUALITY] API returns EF entities instead of DTOs
Description: Besides PersonGetAllEndpoint and ProfileGetUserInfoEndpoint, this happens in all CRUD controllers in Controllers/ folder, EmployeeAddNewEndpoint.cs, admin endpoints (AdminPanelEndpoints.cs — AddUser, AddEmployee), SpeciesGetAllEndpoint.cs, VetStationGetAllEndpoint.cs, and others. Problems: leaking internal fields (including passwords), coupling frontend to DB schema, no control over serialization. Fix: Create response DTOs for each endpoint with only the fields the client needs to see. Files: All controllers and endpoints returning entities

Title: [QUALITY] API returns internal exception messages to client
Description: Endpoints like PetsGetByIdEndpoint.cs, PetsUpdateOrInsertEndpoint.cs, PersonAddEndpoint.cs have catch blocks returning BadRequest(ex.Message) or BadRequest(ex.InnerException.Message). This can expose stack traces, SQL queries, table names. In InventoryController.Add the error message is literally "samir". Fix: Implement global error handling middleware that logs details server-side and returns generic messages to client. Files: Multiple endpoint files, InventoryController

Title: [PERF] PersonAddEndpoint loads entire table for duplicate check
Description: Uses _db.Person.ToList<Person>().Where(x => x.Username == person.Username) — calls .ToList() on the entire Person table then filters in memory. Same in EmployeeAddNewEndpoint. O(n) memory for an O(1) operation. Fix: Replace with _db.Person.AnyAsync(x => x.Username == person.Username). Files: PersonAddEndpoint.cs, EmployeeAddNewEndpoint.cs

Title: [QUALITY] No pagination on list endpoints
Description: PersonGetAllEndpoint returns all records at once, same for EmployeeGetByVetStationId and all GetAll controllers. Fix: Implement pagination with skip/take parameters or cursor-based pagination. Files: PersonGetAllEndpoint, EmployeeGetByVetStationId, all GetAll controllers

Title: [QUALITY] ProfileSettingsEditEndpoint allows duplicate email/username
Description: User can change email or username to a value already used by another user, causing conflicts and login issues. Fix: Before updating, check that the new email/username is not already taken. Files: ProfileSettingsEditEndpoint.cs

Title: [QUALITY] Missing database indexes on frequently filtered fields
Description: DataContext.cs has no explicit HasIndex() calls for fields like email, username, etc. Without indexes, every query does a full table scan. Fix: Add indexes via Fluent API in OnModelCreating. Files: DataContext.cs

Title: [QUALITY] DateTime.Now used instead of DateTime.UtcNow
Description: Used in auth token log, Google auth registration, and elsewhere. If the server is in a different timezone or uses cloud hosting (usually UTC), times will be inconsistent. Fix: Standardize on UTC throughout the project. Files: Multiple files

Title: [BUG] Hardcoded backend URL in registration component
Description: register.component.ts has "let link = "https://localhost:44308/api/Person/Add"" while all other components use Config.address. Other frontend files also have hardcoded URLs. Fix: Centralize all URLs through configuration (Config.address). Files: register.component.ts, other frontend components

Title: [CLEANUP] TokenCleanupService has test class name
Description: Class is declared as "public class something : BackgroundService" — obviously a test name that was never fixed. Fix: Rename to a meaningful name. Files: TokenCleanupService (something.cs)

Title: [BUG] Copy-paste error messages in Employee GET endpoints
Description: EmployeeGetByVetStationIdEndpoint, EmployeeGetBarbersByVetStationId, EmployeeGetNursesByVetStationId, and EmployeeGetVetsByVetStationId all have catch blocks with message "Could not delete: ..." even though they are GET endpoints that don't delete anything. Fix: Correct the error messages. Files: Employee GET endpoint files

Title: [BUG] RoleController methods return void instead of ActionResult
Description: RoleController.Add returns void — client gets no success confirmation. RoleController.Delete also returns void, doesn't check if role exists, and calls ExecuteDelete() then SaveChanges() (double commit). Fix: Return appropriate HTTP status codes. Files: RoleController

Title: [QUALITY] Mixed sync/async endpoint patterns
Description: Some endpoints are async but never use await (e.g., PersonGetAllEndpoint.HandleAsync), while others use await correctly. Async methods without await execute synchronously and generate compiler warnings. Fix: Either use await on async calls or remove the async keyword. Files: Multiple endpoint files

Title: [CLEANUP] Inconsistent naming and typos in code
Description: AuthentificationToken (should be Authentication), LoggTime (double g), IpAdress (should be IpAddress), AppointmentDuaration (should be Duration), enviroment.ts (should be environment), verified (lowercase while all others are PascalCase). Fix: Rename consistently. Files: Multiple model and config files

Title: [BUG] BirthDate defaults to DateTime.Now on Person model
Description: If not set explicitly, every user gets today's date as birth date. For Google registration this happens since Google doesn't return birth date. Fix: Make BirthDate nullable or set a meaningful default. Files: Person.cs

Title: [BUG] Animal.Name is [Required] but declared as string? (nullable)
Description: This is a contradiction that can cause unexpected behavior during validation. Fix: Either remove [Required] or change to non-nullable string. Files: Animal.cs

Title: [UX] No confirmation dialogs for destructive actions on frontend
Description: In pets-settings.component.ts (delete/restore flow), admin panel delete actions, and other places, deletion executes immediately on click without a confirmation modal. Fix: Add confirmation modal before all destructive operations. Files: pets-settings.component.ts, admin panel components

Title: [FEATURE] Dashboard screen not implemented
Description: Dashboard screen reported as a feature is not found. Frontend routing and components don't contain a real dashboard with meaningful content — home-page is a landing page, not a dashboard. Fix: Implement dashboard as a separate route with relevant content, or remove from feature list. Files: Frontend routing, new dashboard component

Title: [CLEANUP] Remove WeatherForecast.cs template file
Description: Default template file from ASP.NET project remains in the repository. Fix: Delete the file. Files: WeatherForecast.cs

Title: [CLEANUP] Confusing PetsEndpoint vs PetsEndpoints folder naming
Description: Folder PetsEndpoint (singular) contains only response DTOs, while PetsEndpoints (plural) contains actual endpoints — confusing duplication. Fix: Consolidate or rename folders for clarity. Files: PetsEndpoint/, PetsEndpoints/
